text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy got injured during training,
so I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...!!
This is nothing to meeee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is no big deal at all, nanoda!
You're worrying way too much, nanoda!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"The Demon King is strong!
I don't need any rest!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So hurry up and let Windy-chan run already-!
choice_data_list: For now, let's take it slow and rest.
...Only if you promise not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna! Are you disobeying the Demon King?!
choice_data_list: I can't listen. Windy is too precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Important...!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...I-Is that so?
Is Windy-chan really that important to you...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Would it make you happy
if Windy-chan took a proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Then it can't be helped, nanoda.
Taking a break once in a while ain't bad either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Shinko Windy spent her time
resting quietly.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that-noda!
Windy-chan does whatever she wants-noda!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! I'm gonna go run right away~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Haa, ha... Ow-ow-ow!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I shouldn't have done that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy said so through her sniffling tears.
I should definitely make sure she gets a proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kufufu! See, I told you!
An injury like this is nothing to me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun!
It's no sweat at all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You don't need to look at me like that, there's no need to worry. Today, I'll run according to the menu!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun.
You should be thanking Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy continued her training without putting strain on the injured area.
Thanks to that, the injury healed quickly.
